raw.title: Greco-Turkish War (1919–1922)
raw.description: Conflict between the Kingdom of Greece and the Turkish National Movement
raw.extract: The Greco-Turkish War of 1919–1922 was fought between Greece and the Turkish National Movement during the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire in the aftermath of World War I, between 15 May 1919 and 14 October 1922. This conflict was a part of the Turkish War of Independence.
